25.title: Central Kolkata big three
25.description: Use: Short in number, but potentially substantial in queueing time. Avoid marketing this as a guaranteed one-hour route. Peak crowd queues can exceed 2 hours at Santosh Mitra Square and College Square.

26.description: Use: A Central-to-North neighbourhood trail without adding the entire Hatibagan circuit. Renowned for metalwork and brass craftsmanship.
